193.flavor: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

194.flavor: 為了在地面上行走時不讓皮膚乾燥，會用有毒的黏膜覆蓋身體。

195.flavor: 身體總是滑溜溜的。雖然游泳時頭總會撞到河底，但牠自己毫不在意。

196.flavor: 從額頭的珠子放射出精神力量進行戰鬥。當力量用盡時，珠子的顏色也會褪去。

197.flavor: 在滿月之夜或是興奮的時候，牠身上圈圈一樣的花紋就會發出金黃色的光。

198.flavor: 會為了老大尋找閃閃發亮的東西。被人們視為不吉利的象徵，厭惡牠的人也很多。

199.flavor: 只要開口提問，任何難題牠都會幫忙解開，但是無人能夠理解呆呆王的語言。

200.flavor: 會藉由模仿人哭叫的聲音嚇唬大家來取樂。不擅長應付膽大的對手。

201.flavor: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

202.flavor: 為了隱藏漆黑的尾巴而悄悄地生活在黑暗之中。不會主動發動攻擊。

203.flavor: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

204.flavor: 會用唾液把樹皮貼在自己身上，讓自己變得更厚更大。上了年紀的榛果球是無比巨大的。

205.flavor: 只有在吞下獵物的瞬間，殼裡的身體才會出現。至今還沒有人見過牠的真面目。

206.flavor: 居住在像是迷宮的巢穴裡。能憑土壤的氣味知道自己的位置，所以絕對不會迷路。

207.flavor: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

208.flavor: 人們認為牠的身體是因為堆積了和泥土一起吞下的鐵質，才會發生變化的。

209.flavor: 個性與外表相反，其實很膽小。要是把牠和其他小狗寶可夢放在一起，牠有可能會被欺負。

210.flavor: 雖然很受年輕女性歡迎，但牠不但膽小而且個性纖細，以看門狗來說一點用都沒有。

211.flavor: 全身上下的小針是由鱗片變化而來的。如果被刺中的話，就會中毒並陷入昏迷。

212.flavor: 體型雖然纖細，攻擊力卻非常駭人。連身體的肌肉都是由金屬構成的。

213.flavor: 儲存在壺形甲殼裡的樹果會在不知不覺間變成黏糊糊的果汁。

214.flavor: 能夠輕輕鬆鬆舉起比自己體重還要重１００倍的物體，是以一身怪力為傲的寶可夢。

215.flavor: 性格狡猾且凶猛。會趁著雙親不在時侵入巢穴把蛋盜走。

216.flavor: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

217.flavor: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

218.flavor: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

219.flavor: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

220.flavor: 一聞到誘人的香味時，就會不顧一切地朝香味傳來的方向飛奔而去。

221.flavor: 雖然４隻腳很短，但因為蹄很寬而且粗糙，所以就算在雪地上行走也不會打滑。

222.flavor: 在溫暖的大海裡生活。也曾經大量棲息於上古時期的伽勒爾近海。

223.flavor: 會用變成吸盤狀的背鰭吸附在巨翅飛魚身上，吃牠平常吃剩下的東西。

224.flavor: 有著堅硬結實的腦袋。會用帶有吸盤的腳纏住對手，然後不停地用頭猛撞。

225.flavor: 因為有跟人類及寶可夢分享自己食物的習性，所以一直都在到處尋找食物。

226.flavor: 悠然地暢游在大海中。就算有覬覦食物殘渣的鐵炮魚吸附在自己身上也毫不在意。

227.flavor: 由於牠脫落下來的羽毛能夠製成劍，因此作為家徽的圖案也很有人氣。

228.flavor: 會在天亮前反覆發出令人不寒而慄的長嚎，藉此強調自己群體的存在。

229.flavor: 特徵是令人不寒而慄的長嚎。過去人們認為牠是來自地獄的使者，對牠十分畏懼。

230.flavor: 脫落的鱗片光澤高雅有深度，甚至被拿去獻給王族作為貢品。

231.flavor: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

232.flavor: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

233.flavor: 搭載了ＡＩ功能後，開始說起了只有多邊獸Ⅱ彼此之間才能了解的神秘語言。

234.flavor: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

235.flavor: 會用尾巴前端分泌出的液體畫下標記。其中有些標記會吸引愛好者以高價買賣。

236.flavor: 體型雖小卻不可輕視，因為牠只要發現合適的對手，就會馬上撲上去大打出手。

237.flavor: 會透過倒立來擾亂對方的節奏，然後趁隙施展華麗的踢擊。

238.flavor: 好奇心旺盛的寶可夢。對於任何東西都會先用嘴唇去觸碰，再決定是喜歡還是討厭這東西。

239.flavor: 還不擅長儲存電力。為了吸食電力，會偷偷潛入民宅尋找插座。

240.flavor: 棲息在火山的周圍。在一天結束時，會泡進熔岩中讓身體舒緩疲勞。

241.flavor: 如果沒有每天擠鮮奶，身體的狀況就會變糟。鮮奶的風味會隨季節改變。

242.flavor: 會生下飽含幸福的神奇的蛋。據說吃下蛋的人，就能夠對任何人都很溫和相待。

243.flavor: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

244.flavor: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

245.flavor: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

246.flavor: 靠吃泥土維生。吃掉一座大山後，就會為了成長而開始沉睡。

247.flavor: 雖然是蛹卻不會呆著不動。在堅硬的甲殼之下已經長出了手腳。

248.flavor: 當牠帶著巨大轟鳴聲邁開腳步，就連大山都會為之崩裂，周遭的地形也會因而改變。

249.flavor: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

250.flavor: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

251.flavor: 從未來穿越時光而來。能夠治癒傷痛，也會把自己的力量分給草木。

252.flavor: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

253.flavor: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

254.flavor: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

255.flavor: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

256.flavor: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.
